sentences.text: Yes; for EMI-based personal loans, the applicable directions require the lender to provide borrowers the option to switch over to a fixed rate at the time of reset of interest rates.
The bank’s retail loan policy is more permissive, saying the bank may, at its option, offer that choice at reset.
Because the in-force directions applicable to this case say the option shall be provided, the policy wording does not answer the question on its own.
